name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter Kovács found her passion for motorsport amidst the rumble of Soviet-era Ladas racing at Hungaroring in her youth. Initially a mechanical engineer, she transitioned into team management after demonstrating an exceptional aptitude for problem-solving and strategic thinking. Her no-nonsense approach and unwavering loyalty have earned her respect throughout the paddock. 

Eszter excels at fostering a collaborative environment, ensuring every team member understands their role in achieving shared objectives. She is known for her long-term vision, focusing on sustainable growth and innovation rather than chasing short-term gains. At Walkinshaw Andretti United, she is determined to build a dynasty founded on technical excellence and unwavering commitment. 

She possesses a unique ability to extract peak performance from individuals, even under immense pressure. Eszter demands excellence, and her teams consistently deliver, making her a formidable leader and a respected figure in the world of motorsport.

physical.description: Eszter is a woman of medium build with a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical schematics.
Refuses to use email, preferring face-to-face communication or handwritten notes.
Has a lucky scarf that she wears to every race, regardless of the weather.
